title: Qwen read my 200-page PDF free, with page citations
description:
Two hundred pages went in on a free account, and the answers came back with page numbers you can open and check.

The workflow is three steps. Go to chat.qwen.ai and upload the whole document, not a chapter. Ask for a page-cited summary — that phrasing is the trick, because it forces every claim to carry a reference into your own file. Then open two of those citations before you trust any of it. That last step is the habit worth keeping, and it works on every tool, not just this one.

Two honest limits, stated plainly. First: the free tier is generous but Alibaba does not publish the exact file size or file count cap for the consumer web chat, so this video does not put a number on screen. The figures you will find quoted elsewhere — 150MB, 10,000 files — come from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's Qwen-Long developer API, which is a different, paid product. Second: Qwen Chat is operated by Alibaba and hosted in China. Read the data terms before you upload work material, and keep confidential, personal or client-owned documents out of it entirely.

Everything shown here was captured live on a free incognito session, because none of it is documented — the only honest proof is the product doing it.
